q: The parity sequence of the Collatz orbit ω_n = C^n(m) mod 2 is used to define a symbolic representation. The Collatz conjecture is equivalent to:
opts: Every parity sequence is eventually periodic with period (0,1)
Every parity sequence is eventually periodic with period (0) or (1,0,0) (corresponding to the cycles 1→2→1 or 1→4→2→1)
exp: The cycles of C on positive integers: 1→2→1 (parity: 1,0) and 1→4→2→1 (parity: 1,0,0) [under accelerated map]. Collatz conjecture: every orbit eventually enters one of these cycles, so every parity sequence is eventually periodic with these periods.
